headline: Banks push back on customers using AI agents
pages: Wells Fargo will put updated terms into effect on Tuesday that warn customers that use of any AI agent is at their own risk. Agents are tools that click and complete online tasks for a user, such as shopping. Wired reports that they have stumbled through 2026, with some early adopters embarrassed when agents made major mistakes, including posting bank details where coworkers could see them. Some users give agents account credentials and sweeping permissions without much thought. Few transactions are completed by autonomous tools so far, but US banks are already wary of third-party agents. Wired says the fight over agents is also a turf war across the wider web. Source: Wired.
